title: Microsoft Teams: Activity in other accounts and orgs improvements
description: Stay up-to-date with what's happening in your other accounts and organizations with the 'Activity in Other Accounts and Orgs' panel. Preview and open chats, channels, and other activity in other accounts and orgs from your main Teams window, without switching tenants.
